title: Unauthenticated visitor is blocked from the student area
description: This verifies that a visitor without a session is prevented from viewing the protected student area.

steps.description: Navigate to /student-online
Verify access to the student area is blocked
Verify the login page is displayed

title: Unauthenticated visitor is blocked from homework
description: This verifies that a visitor without a session is prevented from viewing the protected homework page.

steps.description: Navigate to /student-online/homework
Verify access to the homework page is blocked
Verify the login page is displayed

title: Student logs in and reaches the dashboard
description: This verifies that a student can sign in with valid credentials and land on the authenticated student dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify the student online dashboard is displayed

title: Student sees homework after login
description: This verifies that a signed-in student can open the homework section and view the assigned homework list.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Open the homework section
Verify the homework list is displayed

title: Signed-in student can access the student area
description: This verifies that an authenticated student can access the protected student area after signing in.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /student-online
Verify the student online dashboard is displayed

title: Signed-in student can open homework directly
description: This verifies that an authenticated student can access the homework page directly and see the homework list.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /student-online/homework
Verify the homework list is displayed

title: Authenticated admin can open the admin dashboard
description: This verifies that an authenticated admin or teacher can access the admin area when signed in with the correct role.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /admin
Verify the admin dashboard is displayed

title: Invalid login shows a failure message
description: This verifies that submitting invalid credentials on the login page shows a clear login failure state.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with invalid@example.com
Fill in the password field with invalid-password
Submit the login form
Verify a login failure message is visible
